# JoeSSH Workbench

JoeSSH is a local-first remote workbench for SSH terminals, SFTP file
management, port forwarding, and session management.

## Public Beta Features

- [SSH Terminal](/?action=connect) - Multi-tab terminal sessions with command preflight and safety guardrails
- [SFTP Browser](/?panel=sftp) - File transfer and remote file management
- [Port Forwarding](/?panel=forwarding) - Local port forwarding

Production and Microsoft Store builds exclude the contributor-only Team-access
evaluation screens, Business controls, terminal recording/playback, encrypted
snippet sync, and Mobile/Web companion guidance. These are not available
in the Public Beta.
